title: Where Does Your Spotify Money Really Go?
description:
Where Does Your Spotify Money Really Go?.

Sources:
- Spotify paid $11B+ in 2025 (Storyboard18): https://www.storyboard18.com/brand-marketing/spotify-payouts-cross-11-billion-as-independent-artists-take-larger-share-88427.htm

scenes.narration: You pay Spotify every month. So why does Spotify keep so little of it?
In 2025, Spotify paid more than 11 billion dollars to the music industry, the biggest yearly payout of any music service ever.

visual.label: paid to the music industry in 2025

scenes.narration: That's roughly 70 cents of every music dollar going to labels, publishers and distributors.

visual.label: of music revenue goes to rights holders

scenes.narration: And it goes to rights holders, not straight to artists. Their record deals decide how much artists actually see.
Spotify keeps about 30 cents, and uses it to build podcasts, audiobooks and video. Follow for more.
